law_text: It is unlawful for any person to drive or operate a vehicle of any kind or character at: Such a rate of speed as to endanger the life, limb or property of any person.

alternatives_and_boundaries: Protected interests are life, limb, or property; measure exposure to the stationary pedestrian and owned property separately.
